You imbue yourself with primal power. While active, you gain the following benefits:

**Rage Damage.** When you make an attack using Strength and deal damage, you gain a $(formatBonus(attributes.rageDamage)) bonus to the damage. 

**Strength Advantage.** You have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

**Temporary Hit Points.** You gain $(meta.level * 2) Temporary Hit Points.

**Game Statistics.** Your game statistics are replaced by the Beast's stat block, but you retain your creature type; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.

**No Spellcasting.** You can't cast spells, but shape-shifting doesn't break your Concentration or otherwise interfere with a spell you've already cast.

name: Long Rest
description:
A Long Rest is a period of extended downtime—at least 8 hours—available to any creature. During a Long Rest, you sleep for at least 6 hours and perform no more than 2 hours of light activity, such as reading, talking, eating, or standing watch.
During sleep, you have the Unconscious condition. After you finish a Long Rest, you must wait at least 16 hours before starting another one.
You regain all lost Hit Points and all spent Hit Point Dice.

mechanic.text: Extended downtime (8 hours). Regain all lost Hit Points and spent Hit Point Dice.

name: Opportunity Attack
description: When a creature leaves your reach, you make one melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against the target. The attack occurs right before the creature leaves your reach.

mechanic.trigger: When a creature leaves your reach
mechanic.text: You make one melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against the target. The attack occurs right before the creature leaves your reach.

name: Ready
description:
You take the Ready action to wait for a particular circumstance before you act. To do so, you take this action on your turn, which lets you act by taking a Reaction before the start of your next turn.

First, you decide what perceivable circumstance will trigger your Reaction. Then, you choose the action you will take in response to that trigger, or you choose to move up to your Speed in response to it. Examples include "If the cultist steps on the trapdoor, I'll pull the lever that opens it," and "If the zombie steps next to me, I move away."

When the trigger occurs, you can either take your Reaction right after the trigger finishes or ignore the trigger.

mechanic.text: Set a perceivable trigger to take a Reaction action or move up to your Speed before the start of your next turn.

name: Search
description:
You make a Wisdom check to discern something that isn't obvious. 

**Insight ($(formatBonus(skills.insight.bonus))).** Creature's state of mind

**Medicine ($(formatBonus(skills.medicine.bonus))).** Creature's ailment or cause of death

**Perception ($(formatBonus(skills.perception.bonus))).** Concealed creature or object

**Survival ($(formatBonus(skills.survival.bonus))).** Tracks or food

mechanic.text: Make a Wisdom check (Insight, Medicine, Perception, or Survival) to discern non-obvious details.

name: Short Rest
description:
A Short Rest is a 1-hour period of downtime, during which a creature does nothing more strenuous than reading, talking, eating, or standing watch. To start a Short Rest, you must have at least 1 Hit Point.

**Spend Hit Point Dice.** You can spend one or more of your Hit Point Dice to regain Hit Points. For each Hit Point Die you spend in this way, you regain 1d$(attributes.hitDie)$(formatBonus(stats.con.mod)) Hit Points. You can decide to spend an additional Hit Point Die after each roll.

healing.text: Spend Hit Point Dice to regain Hit Points per die spent.

name: Study
description:
You make an Intelligence check to study your memory, a book, a clue, or another source of knowledge and call to mind an important piece of information about it.

**Arcana ($(formatBonus(skills.arcana.bonus))).** Spells, magic items, eldritch symbols, magical traditions, planes of existence, and certain creatures (Aberrations, Constructs, Elementals, Fey, and Monstrosities)

**History ($(formatBonus(skills.history.bonus))).** Historic events and people, ancient civilizations, wars, and certain creatures (Giants and Humanoids)

**Investigation ($(formatBonus(skills.investigation.bonus))).** Traps, ciphers, riddles, and gadgetry

**Nature ($(formatBonus(skills.nature.bonus))).** Terrain, flora, weather, and certain creatures (Beasts, Dragons, Oozes, and Plants)

**Religion ($(formatBonus(skills.religion.bonus))).** Deities, religious hierarchies and rites, holy symbols, cults, and certain creatures (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead)

mechanic.text: Make an Intelligence check (Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, or Religion) to recall knowledge.

description:
While mounted, you have Advantage on attack rolls against any unmounted creature within 5 feet of your mount that is at least one size smaller than the mount.

If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if it fails. For your mount to gain this benefit, you must be riding it, and neither of you can have the Incapacitated condition.

While you're riding a mount that isn't Incapacitated, you can force an attack that hits the mount to hit you instead if you don't have the Incapacitated condition.

name: Gith

overwrite.description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration and is invisible. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.

The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

name: Gnome
description: Petite, inventive folk imbued with wild wonder, keen intellect, and natural magic.

name: Goliath
description: Towering descendants of giants who command supernatural martial boons and sudden growth.

name: Halfling
description: Small, nimble folk blessed with extraordinary luck, bravery, and a love for hearth and home.

name: Human
description: Ambitious and resourceful mortals whose diverse talents drive them across every realm.

name: Leonin
description: Fierce, golden-furred hunters who value pride, martial prowess, and fierce independence.

name: Minotaur
description: Powerful horned humanoids with an uncanny sense of direction and relentless charge.

name: Orc
description: Strong, driven warriors endowed with Gruumsh's endurance, unyielding grit, and darkvision.

name: Satyr
description: Fey revelers with goatlike legs whose music and magic thrive on unbridled joy.

name: Adrenaline Rush
description: You take the Dash action. When you do so, you gain $(attributes.prof) Temporary Hit Points.

name: Breath Weapon
description: You exhale magical energy in a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line (5 feet wide). Each creature in that area must make a DC $(8 + stats.con.mod + attributes.prof) Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes $(meta.level >= 17 ? '4' : meta.level >= 11 ? '3' : meta.level >= 5 ? '2' : '1')d10 $(attributes.dragonicAncestryDamage) damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

name: Celestial Revelation
description:
You transform. The transformation lasts for the duration or until you end it (no action required). Once on each of your turns before it ends, you can deal $(attributes.prof) extra damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell; the damage is Necrotic for Necrotic Shroud or Radiant for Heavenly Wings and Inner Radiance.

**Heavenly Wings.** You have a Fly Speed of $(attributes.movement.walk) until the transformation ends.

**Inner Radiance.** You shed Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. At the end of each of your turns, each creature within 10 feet of you takes $(attributes.prof) Radiant damage.

**Necrotic Shroud.** Creatures other than your allies within 10 feet of you must succeed on a DC $(attributes.prof + 8 + stats.cha.mod) Charisma saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

blocks.name: Heavenly Wings
blocks.text: Transform for 1 min. Fly Speed equal to Walk Speed. Deal $(attributes.prof) extra Radiant damage once per turn.

blocks.name: Inner Radiance
blocks.text: Transform for 1 min. Shed light. Creatures within 10 ft take $(attributes.prof) Radiant damage at end of your turns.

failure.text: Creatures within 10 ft gain Frightened condition until end of next turn

name: Clockwork Device
description: You spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP), such as a toy, fire starter, or music box. When you create the device, you determine its function by choosing one effect from Prestidigitation; the device produces that effect whenever you or another creature takes a Bonus Action to activate it with a touch. You can have three such devices in existence at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation or when you dismantle it with a touch as a Utilize action.

mechanic.text: Create a Tiny clockwork device producing a chosen Prestidigitation effect for 8 hours.

name: Cloud's Jaunt
description: You magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

mechanic.text: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

name: Daunting Roar
description: You let out a terrifying roar. Each creature of your choice within range must succeed on a DC $(attributes.prof + 8 + stats.con.mod) Wisdom saving throw or have Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of your next turn.

failure.text: Target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until end of your next turn.

name: Draconic Flight
description: You sprout spectral wings on your back for 10 minutes or until you retract them (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition. During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

mechanic.text: Sprout spectral wings for 10 minutes granting Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Fire's Burn
description: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.

mechanic.trigger: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it

name: Frost's Chill
description: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

mechanic.trigger: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it
mechanic.text: Reduce target's Speed by 10 feet until start of your next turn.

name: Halfling Nimbleness
description: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can't stop in the same space.

mechanic.text: Move through the space of any creature a size larger than you.

name: Healing Hands
description: You touch a creature and roll $(attributes.prof)d4. The creature regains Hit Points equal to the total rolled.

name: Hill's Tumble
description: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you give that target the Prone condition.

mechanic.trigger: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage
mechanic.text: Target gains the Prone condition.

name: Large Form
description: You change your size to Large if you're in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet.

mechanic.text: Size becomes Large for 10 min. Advantage on Strength checks and +10 ft Speed.

name: Luck
description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

mechanic.trigger: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test
mechanic.text: Reroll the die and use the new roll.

name: Relentless Endurance
description: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead.

mechanic.trigger: When reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright
mechanic.text: Drop to 1 Hit Point instead.

name: Stonecunning
description: You gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching a stone surface to use this Tremorsense. The stone can be natural or worked.

mechanic.text: Gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes while on stone.

name: Stone's Endurance
description: When you take damage, reduce it by 1d12$(formatBonus(stats.con.mod)).

mechanic.trigger: When you take damage
mechanic.text: Reduce damage taken by 1d12$(formatBonus(stats.con.mod)).

name: Storm's Thunder
description: When you take damage from a creature within range, deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.

mechanic.trigger: When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet

name: Pounce
description: Once per turn, you can use both the Damage and Shove options.

name: Naturally Stealthy
description: You can Hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

name: Resourceful
description: You gain Heroic Inspiration.

name: Sentry's Rest
description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 6 hours if you spend those hours in an inactive, motionless state. During this time, you appear inert but remain conscious.

name: Tireless
description: You don't gain Exhaustion levels from dehydration, malnutrition, or suffocation.

name: Trance
description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

name: Tiefling
description: Mortals carrying a fiendish heritage that sparks supernatural power and planar resistance.

name: Triton
description: Aquatic guardians from the Plane of Water who defend both ocean depths and surface shores.

name: Warforged
description: Mechanical beings, infused with alchemical fluids and wooden-metal bodies capable of pain and emotion.

name: Acid Splash
summary: You hurl a bubble of acid that bursts into a damaging splash.
description: You create an acidic bubble at a point within range, where it explodes in a 5-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in that Sphere must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Dexterity saving throw or take $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d6 Acid damage.

name: Blade Ward
summary: You ward yourself against weapon attacks.
description: Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you before the spell ends, the attacker subtracts 1d4 from the attack roll.

mechanic.trigger: You are hit by an attack roll
mechanic.text: Add 1d4 to your AC against the triggering attack.

name: Chill Touch
summary: You channel skeletal cold to strike a target and hamper its healing.
description: Channeling the chill of the grave, make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) melee spell attack against a target within reach. On a hit, the target takes $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d10 Necrotic damage, and it can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.

mechanic.text: Target cannot regain hit points until the end of your next turn.

name: Dancing Lights
summary: You create up to four lights that hover or move at your command.
description:
You create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration. Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.

As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.

name: Druidcraft
summary: You channel nature magic to create subtle wilderness effects.
description:
Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range.

**Weather Sensor.** You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round.

**Bloom.** You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom.

**Sensory Effect.** You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube.

**Fire Play.** You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.

name: Eldritch Blast
summary: A beam of crackling energy lances toward a target.
description: You hurl $(meta.level >= 5 ? (meta.level >= 17 ? 'four' : meta.level >= 11 ? 'three' : 'two') + ' beams' : 'a beam') of crackling energy. Make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) ranged spell attack $(meta.level >= 5 ? 'for each beam' : 'against one creature or object in range'). On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Force damage.

name: Elementalism
summary: You manipulate elemental forces to create minor elemental effects.
description:
You exert control over the elements, creating one of the following effects within range.

**Beckon Air.** You create a breeze strong enough to ripple cloth, stir dust, rustle leaves, and close open doors and shutters, all in a 5-foot Cube. Doors and shutters being held open by someone or something aren't affected.

**Beckon Earth.** You create a thin shroud of dust or sand that covers surfaces in a 5-foot-square area, or you cause a single word to appear in your handwriting in a patch of dirt or sand.

**Beckon Fire.** You create a thin cloud of harmless embers and colored, scented smoke in a 5-foot Cube. You choose the color and scent, and the embers can light candles, torches, or lamps in that area. The smoke's scent lingers for 1 minute.

**Beckon Water.** You create a spray of cool mist that lightly dampens creatures and objects in a 5-foot Cube. Alternatively, you create 1 cup of clean water either in an open container or on a surface, and the water evaporates in 1 minute.

**Sculpt Element.** You cause dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water that can fit in a 1-foot Cube to assume a crude shape (such as that of a creature) for 1 hour.

name: Fire Bolt
summary: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object.
description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object within range. Make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried.

name: Friends
summary: You magically enhance your charisma against a single creature.
description:
You magically emanate a sense of friendship toward one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target succeeds automatically if it isn't a Humanoid, if you're fighting it, or if you have cast this spell on it within the past 24 hours.

The spell ends early if the target takes damage or if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or force anyone to make a saving throw. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.

failure.text: Target has the Charmed condition for 1 minute.

name: Guidance
summary: You touch a creature to grant a minor boost to its next skill check.
description: You touch a willing creature and choose a skill. Until the spell ends, the creature adds 1d4 to any ability check using the chosen skill.

mechanic.text: Target adds 1d4 to any ability check using a chosen skill.

name: Light
summary: You make an object shine with bright light.
description:
You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.

Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.

name: Mage Hand
summary: You create a spectral hand to manipulate objects at a distance.
description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.

The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

name: Mending
summary: You repair a single break or tear in an object.
description:
This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage.

This spell can physically repair a magic item, but it can't restore magic to such an object.

name: Message
summary: You whisper a secret message to a target at a distance.
description:
You point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.

You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.

name: Mind Sliver
summary: You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into a target mind.
description: You try to temporarily sliver the mind of one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on an DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Intelligence saving throw or take $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d6 Psychic damage and subtract 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.

failure.text: Target subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw before the end of your next turn.

name: Minor Illusion
summary: You create a sound or an image of an object within range.
description:
You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.

If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save). If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

**Sound.** If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends.

**Image.** If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.

name: Poison Spray
summary: You project a puff of noxious gas at a nearby creature.
description: You spray toxic mist at a creature within range. Make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d12 Poison damage.

name: Prestidigitation
summary: You perform minor magical tricks and utility effects.
description:
You create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time.

**Sensory Effect.** You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor.

**Fire Play.** You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.

**Clean or Soil.** You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot.

**Minor Sensation.** You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour.

**Magic Mark.** You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour.

**Minor Creation.** You create a nonmagical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.

name: Produce Flame
summary: A flickering flame appears in your hand for light or throwing.
description:
A flickering flame appears in your hand and remains there for the duration. While there, the flame emits no heat and ignites nothing, and it sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The spell ends if you cast it again.

Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to hurl fire at a creature or an object within 60 feet of you. Make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d8 Fire damage.

name: Ray of Frost
summary: A frigid beam of blue-white light strikes and slows a target.
description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

mechanic.text: Target speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Resistance
summary: You touch a creature to grant a minor boost to its next saving throw.
description: You touch a willing creature and choose a damage type: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Radiant, Slashing, or Thunder. When the creature takes damage of the chosen type before the spell ends, the creature reduces the total damage taken by 1d4. A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.

mechanic.text: Target adds 1d4 to a saving throw of its choice.

name: Sacred Flame
summary: Flame-like radiance descends on a target.
description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Dexterity saving throw or take $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this save.

name: Shillelagh
summary: Nature magic imbues your wooden weapon with force.
description:
A Club or Quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you make attack rolls with it with a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) modifier and deal 1d8$(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.bonus)) Force damage.

The spell ends early if you cast it again or if you let go of the weapon.

mechanic.text: Nature magic imbues your wooden weapon with force.

name: Shocking Grasp
summary: Lightning springs from your hand to shock a target.
description: Lightning springs from you to a creature that you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

mechanic.text: Target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

name: Spare the Dying
summary: You touch a dying creature to stabilize it.
description: Choose a creature within range that has 0 Hit Points and isn't dead. The creature becomes Stable.

mechanic.text: A living creature at 0 Hit Points becomes Stable.

name: Starry Wisp
summary: You launch a twinkling mote of light that illuminates a target.
description: You launch a mote of light at one creature or object within range. Make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d8 Radiant damage, and until the end of your next turn, it emits Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.

mechanic.text: Target emits Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and cannot benefit from Invisible condition.

name: Telekinetic Fling
summary: You wreathe a small object in psionic energy and launch it at a target.
description: Choose one nonmagical object weighing 1 to 5 pounds within 10 feet of you that isn't being worn or carried to wreathe in psionic energy and fire at a creature within range. Make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d10 Force damage. On a hit or miss, the object falls to the ground undamaged.

name: Thaumaturgy
summary: You manifest minor wonders and supernatural signs.
description:
You manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time.

**Altered Eyes.** You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.

**Booming Voice.** Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks.

**Fire Play.** You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute.

**Invisible Hand.** You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut.

**Phantom Sound.** You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers.

**Tremors.** You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.

name: Thunderclap
summary: You create a burst of thunderous noise that damages nearby targets.
description: Each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from you must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Constitution saving throw or take $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d6 Thunder damage. The spell's thunderous sound can be heard up to 100 feet away.

name: Toll the Dead
summary: A painful bell toll echoes, dealing necrotic damage.
description: You point at one creature you can see within range, and the single chime of a dolorous bell is audible within 10 feet of the target. The target must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw or take $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d8 Necrotic damage. If the target is missing any of its Hit Points, it instead takes 1d12 Necrotic damage.

name: True Strike
summary: Magical insight guides your next strike.
description: Guided by a flash of magical insight, you make one attack with the weapon used in the spell's casting. Make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) attack roll. On a hit, deal your weapon's damage die $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.bonus)) Radiant damage.

name: Vicious Mockery
summary: You unleash subtle enchantments to disorient a creature.
description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at one creature you can see or hear within range. The target must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw or take $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d6 Psychic damage and have Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

failure.text: Target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

name: Word of Radiance
summary: Burning radiance erupts around you.
description: Burning radiance erupts from you in a 5-foot Emanation. Each creature of your choice that you can see in it must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Constitution saving throw or take $(meta.level >= 17 ? 4 : meta.level >= 11 ? 3 : meta.level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)d6 Radiant damage.

name: Alarm
summary: You set a magical alarm against intrusion.
description:
You set an alarm against intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-foot Cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a creature touches or enters the warded area. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures that won't set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is audible or mental:

**Audible Alarm.** The alarm produces the sound of a handbell for 10 seconds within 60 feet of the warded area.

**Mental Alarm.** You are alerted by a mental ping if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you're asleep.

name: Animal Friendship
summary: You convince a beast that you mean it no harm.
description: Target a Beast that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spells ends.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: You can target one additional Beast for each spell slot level above 1.

failure.text: Target has the Charmed condition for 24 hours.

name: Eldritch Armor
summary: Protective frost surrounds you, granting temporary hit points and cold retaliatory damage.
description: Protective magical frost surrounds you. You gain 5 Temporary Hit Points. If a creature hits you with a melee attack roll before the spell ends, the creature takes 5 Cold damage. The spell ends early if you have no Temporary Hit Points.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The Temporary Hit Points and the Cold damage both increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 1.

mechanic.text: Gain 5 Temporary Hit Points. While active, any creature hitting you with a melee attack takes 5 Cold damage.

name: Eldritch Arms
summary: Dark tendrils erupt around you to strike nearby foes.
description: Invoking Hadar, you cause tendrils to erupt from yourself. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you makes a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

failure.text: Target cannot take Reactions until start of its next turn.

name: Bane
summary: You weaken the resolve and accuracy of up to three targets.
description: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must each make a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Charisma saving throw. Whenever a target that fails this save makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must subtract 1d4 from the attack roll or save.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

failure.text: Targets subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws.

name: Bless
summary: You bless up to three allies, boosting their attacks and saves.
description: You bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

mechanic.text: Targets add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

name: Burning Hands
summary: A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your fingertips.
description:
A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from you. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Flammable objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Charm Person
summary: You charm a humanoid to regard you as a friendly acquaintance.
description: One Humanoid you can see within range makes a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw. It does so with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The Charmed creature is Friendly to you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

failure.text: Target is Charmed for 1 hour.

name: Chromatic Orb
summary: You hurl an orb of elemental energy at a target.
description:
You hurl an orb of energy at a target within range. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder for the type of orb you create, and then make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 3d8 damage of the chosen type.

If you roll the same number on two or more of the d8s, the orb leaps to a different target of your choice within 30 feet of the target. Make an attack roll against the new target, and make a new damage roll. The orb can't leap again unless you cast the spell with a level 2+ spell slot.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1. The orb can leap a maximum number of times equal to the level of the slot expended, and a creature can be targeted only once by each casting of this spell.

name: Color Spray
summary: You launch a dazzling array of flashing lights to blind targets.
description: You launch a dazzling array of flashing, colorful light. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone originating from you must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn.

failure.text: Targets have Blinded condition until end of your next turn.

name: Command
summary: You speak a one-word command that a target must obey.
description:
You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. Choose the command from these options:

**Approach.** The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you.

**Drop.** The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn.

**Flee.** The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means.

**Grovel.** The target has the Prone condition and then ends its turn.

**Halt.** On its turn, the target doesn't move and takes no action or Bonus Action.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: You can affect one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

failure.text: Target obeys your command on its next turn.

name: Compelled Duel
summary: You compel a creature to focus its attacks on you.
description:
You try to compel a creature into a duel. One creature that you can see within range makes a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you, and it can't willingly move to a space that is more than 30 feet away from you.

The spell ends if you make an attack roll against a creature other than the target, if you cast a spell on an enemy other than the target, if an ally of yours damages the target, or if you end your turn more than 30 feet away from the target.

failure.text: Target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against others and must save to move away.

name: Comprehend Languages
summary: You understand the literal meaning of any spoken or written language.
description: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any language that you hear or see signed. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text. This spell doesn't decode symbols or secret messages.

name: Create or Destroy Water
summary: You create or destroy a quantity of water or fog.
description:
You do one of the following:

**Create Water.** You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there.

**Destroy Water.** You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: You create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the Cube increases by 5 feet, for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Cure Wounds
summary: A creature you touch regains hit points.
description: A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8$(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.bonus)).

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Detect Evil and Good
summary: You sense the presence of otherworldly creatures nearby.
description:
For the duration, you sense the location of any Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead within 30 feet of yourself. You also sense whether the Hallow spell is active there and, if so, where.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

name: Detect Magic
summary: You sense the presence and aura of magical effects nearby.
description:
For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

name: Detect Poison and Disease
summary: You sense the location of poisons, venom, and contagions.
description:
For the duration, you sense the location of poisons, poisonous or venomous creatures, and magical contagions within 30 feet of yourself. You sense the kind of poison, creature, or contagion in each case.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

name: Disguise Self
summary: You alter your appearance with illusory magic.
description:
You make yourself - including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person - look different until the spell ends. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. You must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs as you have. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.

The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing.

To discern that you are disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save).

name: Dissonant Whispers
summary: You whisper a discordant melody that causes psychic agony and forces retreat.
description: One creature of your choice that you can see within range hears a discordant melody in its mind. The target makes a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 Psychic damage and must immediately use its Reaction, if available, to move as far away from you as it can, using the safest route. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

failure.text: Target must use Reaction to move as far away as possible.

name: Divine Favor
summary: Your weapon attacks deal extra radiant damage.
description: Until the spell ends, your attacks with weapons deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on a hit.

mechanic.text: Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage.

name: Divine Smite
summary: Your strike unleashes a burst of extra radiant damage.
description: Immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, the target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from the attack. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Fiend or an Undead.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

mechanic.trigger: You hit a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
mechanic.text: The target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from the attack (3d8 against Fiends or Undead).

name: Ensnaring Strike
summary: Your weapon strike summons grasping vines to restrain a target.
description:
Immediately after hitting a creature with a weapon, grasping vines appear on it, and it makes a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Strength saving throw. A Large or larger creature has Advantage on this save. On a failed save, the target has the Restrained condition until the spell ends. On a successful save, the vines shrivel away, and the spell ends.

While Restrained, the target takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save). On a success, the spell ends.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

failure.text: Target is Restrained by grasping vines and takes 1d6 Piercing damage at start of turn.

name: Entangle
summary: Grasping plants sprout to entangle creatures in an area.
description:
Grasping plants sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into Difficult Terrain. They disappear when the spell ends.

Each creature (other than you) in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition until the spell ends. A Restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save). On a success, it frees itself from the grasping plants and is no longer Restrained by them.

failure.text: Target is Restrained in difficult terrain.

name: Expeditious Retreat
summary: You move with sudden speed, allowing continuous dashing.
description: You take the Dash action, and until the spell ends, you can take that action again as a Bonus Action.

name: Faerie Fire
summary: Outlines of light illuminate targets, granting advantage on attack rolls against them.
description:
Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Dexterity saving throw. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.

Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.

failure.text: Targets shed Dim Light and attack rolls against them have Advantage.

name: False Life
summary: You bolster yourself with a vitality boost of temporary hit points.
description: You gain 2d4+4 Temporary Hit Points.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: You gain 5 additional Temporary Hit Points for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Feather Fall
summary: You slow the descent of falling creatures to land safely.
description: Immediately after you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you falls, choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If a creature lands before the spell ends, the creature takes no damage from the fall, and the spell ends for that creature.

mechanic.trigger: You or a creature within 60 feet falls
mechanic.text: Falling rate slows to 60 feet per round and targets take no fall damage.

name: Fog Cloud
summary: You create a bank of dense fog that blocks vision.
description: You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The Sphere is Heavily Obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (such as one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The fog's radius increases by 20 feet for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Goodberry
summary: You infuse berries with healing magic to restore hit points.
description:
Ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

Uneaten berries disappear when the spell ends.

mechanic.text: Creates 10 berries. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point.

name: Grease
summary: Slick grease covers the ground, turning it into difficult terrain.
description:
Nonflammable grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into Difficult Terrain for the duration.

When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on that save or fall Prone.

failure.text: Target falls Prone in the greased area.

name: Guiding Bolt
summary: You hurl a bolt of radiance that illuminates the target for the next attack.
description: You hurl a bolt of light toward a creature within range. Make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 4d6 Radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

mechanic.text: Next attack roll against target before end of your next turn has Advantage.

name: Hail of Thorns
summary: Your ranged strike creates a burst of thorny rain.
description: Immediately after hitting a creature with a Ranged weapon, this spell creates a rain of thorns that sprouts from your Ranged weapon or ammunition. The target of the attack and each creature within 5 feet of it make a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d10 Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Healing Word
summary: A quick word of magic heals a target at a distance.
description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4$(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.bonus)).

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The healing increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Hellish Rebuke
summary: You retaliate against damage with green hellfire.
description: Immediately after taking damage from a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself, the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by green flames. It makes a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.

mechanic.trigger: You take damage from a creature within 60 feet

name: Heroism
summary: A willing creature is imbued with bravery and temporary hit points.
description: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to the Frightened condition and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to $(attributes.spellcasting.bonus) at the start of each of its turns.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

mechanic.text: Target is immune to Frightened and gains Temp HP equal to your spellcasting modifier at start of turn.

name: Hex
summary: You curse a target, dealing extra necrotic damage on attacks.
description:
You place a curse on a creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell. The target has Disadvantage on ability checks made with the chosen ability.

If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action on a later turn to curse a new creature.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: Your Concentration can last longer with a spell slot of level 2 (up to 4 hours), 3–4 (up to 8 hours), or 5+ (24 hours).

mechanic.text: Target takes an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage whenever you hit it with an attack.

name: Hunter's Mark
summary: You magically mark a target as your quarry, dealing extra weapon damage.
description:
You magically mark one creature you can see within range as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 Force damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. You also have Advantage on any Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check you make to find it.

If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: Your Concentration can last longer with a spell slot of level 3–4 (up to 8 hours) or 5+ (up to 24 hours).

mechanic.text: You deal an extra 1d6 Force damage to target whenever you hit it with an attack.

name: Ice Knife
summary: You fling a shard of ice that pierces a target and explodes into cold shards.
description: You create a shard of ice and fling it at one creature within range. Make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Piercing damage. Hit or miss, the shard then explodes. The target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 Cold damage.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The Cold damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Identify
summary: You learn the magical properties of an object or spell effect.
description:
You touch an object throughout the spell's casting. If the object is a magic item or some other magical object, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires Attunement, and how many charges it has, if any. You learn whether any ongoing spells are affecting the item and what they are. If the item was created by a spell, you learn that spell's name.

If you instead touch a creature throughout the casting, you learn which ongoing spells, if any, are currently affecting it.

name: Illusory Script
summary: You write a message that appears normal only to designated readers.
description:
You write on parchment, paper, or another suitable material and imbue it with an illusion that lasts for the duration. To you and any creatures you designate when you cast the spell, the writing appears normal, seems to be written in your hand, and conveys whatever meaning you intended when you wrote the text. To all others, the writing appears as if it were written in an unknown or magical script that is unintelligible. Alternatively, the illusion can alter the meaning, handwriting, and language of the text, though the language must be one you know.

If the spell is dispelled, the original script and the illusion both disappear.

A creature that has Truesight can read the hidden message.

name: Inflict Wounds
summary: Your touch inflicts heavy necrotic damage.
description: A creature you touch makes a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Jump
summary: You touch a creature to triple its jump distance.
description: You touch a willing creature. Once on each of its turns until the spell ends, that creature can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

mechanic.text: A willing creature can jump up to 30 feet by expending 10 feet of movement for 1 minute.

name: Longstrider
summary: You touch a creature to increase its movement speed.
description: You touch a creature. The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Mage Armor
summary: You touch an unarmored creature to grant a protective magical forcefield.
description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.

mechanic.text: Target unarmored base AC becomes 13 + DEX modifier.

name: Magic Missile
summary: You create darts of magical force that automatically strike their targets.
description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart strikes a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4+1 Force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The spell creates one more dart for each spell slot level above 1.

mechanic.text: Create 3 darts that automatically hit for 1d4+1 Force damage each.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
summary: You protect a willing creature against otherworldly entities.
description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against creatures that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can't be possessed by or gain the Charmed or Frightened conditions from them. If the target is already possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such a creature, the target has Advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.

mechanic.text: Target gets protection against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead.

name: Purify Food and Drink
summary: You cleanse nonmagical food and drink of poison and rot.
description: You remove poison and rot from nonmagical food and drink in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range.

name: Ray of Sickness
summary: You shoot a greenish ray that deals poison damage and sickening illness.
description: You shoot a greenish ray at a creature within range. Make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

mechanic.text: Target makes a CON save or has Poisoned condition for 1 round.

name: Sanctuary
summary: You ward a creature, causing attackers to hesitate before striking it.
description:
You ward a creature within range. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack roll or a damaging spell must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw or either choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This spell doesn't protect the warded creature from areas of effect.

The spell ends if the warded creature makes an attack roll, casts a spell, or deals damage.

mechanic.text: Attackers targeting the warded creature must make a WIS save or choose a new target.

name: Shield
summary: An imperceptible barrier of force raises your AC to block attacks.
description: Immediately after being hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell, an imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.

mechanic.trigger: you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell
mechanic.text: You have a +5 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack.

name: Shield of Faith
summary: A shimmering field of protective magic grants +2 AC to a target.
description: A shimmering field surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

mechanic.text: Target gains +2 bonus to AC.

name: Silent Image
summary: You create a visual illusion of an object or creature.
description:
You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot Cube. The image appears at a spot within range and lasts for the duration. The image is purely visual; it isn't accompanied by sound, smell, or other sensory effects.

As a Magic action, you can cause the image to move to any spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can alter the image so that it appears to be walking.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it. A creature that takes a Study action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save). If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image.

name: Sleep
summary: You incapacitate creatures in an area with a magical slumber.
description:
Each creature of your choice in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw or have the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the target fails the second save, the target has the Unconscious condition for the duration. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell's effect.

Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

failure.text: Target falls asleep (Incapacitated and Unconscious condition) until taking damage or woken.

name: Speak with Animals
summary: You gain the ability to comprehend and speak with beasts.
description:
For the duration, you can comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts, and you can use any of the Influence action's skill options with them.

Most Beasts have little to say about topics that don't pertain to survival or companionship, but at minimum, a Beast can give you information about nearby locations and monsters, including whatever it has perceived within the past day.

name: Hideous Laughter
summary: You cause a target to collapse into fits of uncontrollable laughter.
description:
One creature of your choice that you can see within range makes a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Prone and Incapacitated conditions for the duration. During that time, it laughs uncontrollably if it's capable of laughter, and it can't end the Prone condition on itself.

At the end of each of its turns and each time it takes damage, it makes another DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw. The target has Advantage on the save if the save is triggered by damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level about 1.

failure.text: Target falls Prone and has Incapacitated condition from laughter.

name: Floating Disk
summary: You create a floating plane of force that follows you carrying cargo.
description:
This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The disk remains for the duration and can hold up to 500 pounds. If more weight is placed on it, the spell ends, and everything on the disk falls to the ground.

The disk is immobile while you are within 20 feet of it. If you move more than 20 feet away from it, the disk follows you so that it remains within 20 feet of you. It can move across uneven terrain, up or down stairs, slopes and the like, but it can't cross an elevation change of 10 feet or more. For example, the disk can't move across a 10-foot-deep pit, nor could it leave such a pit if it was created at the bottom.

If you move more than 100 feet from the disk (typically because it can't move around an obstacle to follow you), the spell ends.

name: Thunderous Smite
summary: Your strike rings with thunder that knocks a target back.
description: Immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, your strike rings with thunder that is audible within 300 feet of you, and the target takes an extra 2d6 Thunder damage from the attack. Additionally, if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from you and have the Prone condition.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

failure.text: Pushed 10 feet away and falls Prone.

mechanic.trigger: Immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

name: Thunderwave
summary: You unleash a wave of thunderous energy that pushes nearby objects and foes.
description:
You unleash a wave of thunderous energy. Each creature in a 15-foot Cube originating from you makes a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

In addition, unsecured objects that are entirely within the Cube are pushed 10 feet away from you, and a thunderous boom is audible within 300 feet.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

failure.text: Pushed 10 feet away.

name: Unseen Servant
summary: You create an invisible force to perform simple tasks for you.
description:
This spell creates an Invisible, mindless, shapeless, Medium force that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends. The servant springs into existence in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. It has AC 10, 1 Hit Point, and a Strength of 2, and it can't attack. If it drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends.

Once on each of your turns as a Bonus Action, you can mentally command the servant to move up to 15 feet and interact with an object. The servant can perform simple tasks that a human could do, such as fetching things, cleaning, mending, folding clothes, lighting fires, serving food, and pouring drinks. Once you give the command, the servant performs the task to the best of its ability until it completes the task, then waits for your next command.

If you command the servant to perform a task that would move it more than 60 feet away from you, the spell ends.

name: Witch Bolt
summary: You form a sustained arc of crackling lightning between yourself and a target.
description:
A beam of crackling energy lances toward a creature within range, forming a sustained arc of lightning between you and the target. Make a $(formatBonus(attributes.spellcasting.attack)) ranged spell attack against it. On a hit, the target takes 2d12 Lightning damage.

On each of your subsequent turns, you can take a Bonus Action to deal 1d12 Lightning damage to the target automatically, even if the first attack missed.

The spell ends if the target is ever outside the spell's range or if it has Total Cover from you.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The initial damage increases by 1d12 for each spell slot level above 1.

mechanic.text: Bonus Action on subsequent turns deals 1d12 Lightning damage automatically.

name: Wrathful Smite
summary: Your strike inflicts necrotic damage and frightens the target.
description: Immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, the target takes an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage from the attack, and it must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, the Frightened target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

blocks.trigger: Immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

failure.text: Target has Frightened condition until spell ends.

name: Aid
summary: You bolster your allies with toughness and extra hit points.
description: Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: Each target's Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.

mechanic.text: Three targets gain 5 Current and Max Hit Points.

name: Alter Self
summary: You alter your physical form to aquatic, weaponized, or cosmetic traits.
description:
You alter your physical form. Choose one of the following options. Its effects last for the duration, during which you can take a Magic action to replace the option you chose with a different one.

**Aquatic Adaptation.** You sprout gills and grow webs between your fingers. You can breathe underwater and gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

**Change Appearance.** You alter your appearance. You decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and other distinguishing characteristics. You can make yourself appear as a member of another species, though none of your statistics change. You can't appear as a creature of a different size, and your basic shape stays the same; if you're bipedal, you can't use this spell to become quadrupedal, for instance. For the duration, you can take a Magic action to change your appearance in this way again.

**Natural Weapons.** You grow claws (Slashing), fangs (Piercing), horns (Piercing), or hooves (Bludgeoning). When you use your Unarmed Strike to deal damage with that new growth, it deals 1d6 damage of the type in parentheses instead of dealing the normal damage for your Unarmed Strike, and you use $(attributes.spellcasting.bonus) for the attack and damage rolls rather than using Strength.

name: Barkskin
summary: Your skin turns bark-like, granting armor protection.
description: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin assumes a bark-like appearance, and the target has an Armor Class of 17 if its AC is lower than that.

mechanic.text: Target AC cannot be less than 16.

name: Blur
summary: Your body becomes blurred, imposing disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
description: Your body becomes blurred. For the duration, any creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it perceives you with Blindsight or Truesight.

mechanic.text: Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage unless attacker doesn't rely on sight.

name: Cloud Of Daggers
summary: You conjure a swirling cloud of razor-sharp daggers in an area.
description:
You conjure spinning daggers in a 5-foot Cube centered on a point within range. Each creature in that area takes 4d4 Slashing damage. A creature also takes this damage if it enters the Cube or ends its turn there or if the Cube moves into its space. A creature takes this damage only once per turn.

On your later turns, you can take a Magic action to teleport the Cube up to 30 feet.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above 2.

mechanic.text: Conjure daggers in a 5-foot Cube dealing 4d4 Slashing damage to creatures entering or starting turn inside.

name: Darkness
summary: Magical darkness spreads from a point, blocking vision and darkvision.
description:
For the duration, magical Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere. Darkvision can't see through it, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness.

If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

name: Detect Thoughts
summary: You read the surface thoughts or probe deeper into the mind of a target.
description:
You activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns.

**Sense Thoughts.** You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don't read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

**Read Thoughts.** Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target's mind right now. If the target doesn't know any languages and isn't telepathic, you learn nothing.

As a Magic action on your next turn, you can try to probe deeper into the target's mind. If you probe deeper, the target makes a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you discern the target's reasoning, emotions, and something that looms large in its mind (such as a worry, love, or hate). On a successful save, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and until you shift your attention away from the target's mind, the target can take an action on its turn to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save), ending the spell on a success.

failure.text: Read surface thoughts or probe deeper into the mind of a target.

name: Dragon's Breath
summary: You touch one willing creature, and choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.
description: You touch one willing creature, and choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. Until the spell ends, the target can take a Magic action to exhale a 15-foot Cone. Each creature in that area makes a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 damage of the chosen type on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Heat Metal
summary: You cause a manufactured metal object to glow red-hot, burning the wearer.
description:
Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of Heavy or Medium metal armor, that you can see within range. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with the object takes 2d8 Fire damage when you cast the spell. Until the spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action on each of your later turns to deal this damage again if the object is within range.

If a creature is holding or wearing the object and takes the damage from it, the creature must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Constitution saving throw or drop the object if it can. If it doesn't drop the object, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

failure.text: Target drops metal object if possible or has Disadvantage on attack rolls.

name: Hold Person
summary: You paralyze a humanoid target with binding magic.
description: Choose a Humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a DC $(attributes.spellcasting.save) Wisdom saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
extra.description: You can target one additional Humanoid for each spell slot level above 2.

failure.text: Target has the Paralyzed condition.

name: Invisibility
summary: A creature you touch becomes invisible until it attacks or casts.
description: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

extra.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
